milestone.title: M158 + M162 follow-up — recursive skill deploy + full top-5-suite spawn-site conversion

intent.outcome: After this ships, mp install deploys every file in the skill source directory (not just SKILL.md) to ~/.agents/skills/<id>/; a new test parses SKILL.md for `[name.md](name.md)` references and asserts every target exists on disk. Separately, the M162 pilot (7 of 392 spawn sites converted) is extended: the remaining ~385 spawn sites in suite_validate / suite_fragment / suite_milestone / suite_step / suite_plan are converted to in-process lib_api calls, with parity tests asserting byte-identical output where shape agrees. The wall-clock target is dropped in favor of a code-clarity / test-count metric (per Entry 28's structural finding).

problem.description: Two test-surface dogfood findings persist post-M162: (1) M158 (lifecycle=approved, execution_status=deferred) authored the recursive-skill-deploy fix but never landed; the bug is that crates/mp/src/install.rs:755-777 hardcodes `let skill_path = skill_dir.join("SKILL.md")` and only ships that one file, so SKILL.md references to flow-stages.md / planning.md / hitl-loop.template.sh / stages.toml 404 at runtime. (2) M162 (Entry 28) shipped a 7-of-392 pilot; the remaining 385 spawn sites are mechanical conversions that buy code clarity (single call surface, less indirection) but not the ≥20% wall-clock drop the original AC-04 over-claimed. Both are dogfood-log entries that need a follow-up milestone.

in_scope: M158 fix (Entry 23): rewrite deploy_skill_to_harness (crates/mp/src/install.rs:755-777) to walk the source directory recursively (skipping manifest.json) and copy every file to ~/.agents/skills/<id>/. Mirror the change in install_project_skill (install.rs:793-857). Add a SKILL.md link-resolution test that parses each shipped SKILL.md for `[<name>.md](<name>.md)` and `[<name>.toml](<name>.toml)` references and asserts each target exists on disk post-install. Cover every v1 skill: mp-flow, mp-runner, mp-coordinator, codebase-design, code-review, diagnosing-bugs, git-reviewer, github-explorer, mp-code-review, obsidian-*.

M158 promotion: M158 was authored with `spec_status: ready` but is execution_status=deferred. Either (a) the M158 spec is re-used as-is (its scope and ACs already cover the fix), and this milestone just retires the deferral; or (b) this milestone's M158-style fix is the body, M158 itself is closed as wont-fix (subsumed). Path (a) preferred — fewer files, one source of truth.

M162 full conversion (Entry 28): extend crates/mp/tests/common/lib_api.rs to wrap every `mp <cmd>` invocation used by the top-5 suites. Convert each `env.run(&[...])` to `lib_api::<cmd>(...)` per the M162 taxonomy doc. Track conversion counts per suite in the milestone's evidence field. Add a `lib_api_parity_*` test for each new wrapper asserting shape parity against a captured CLI invocation.

M162 AC rewrite: drop AC-02 (≥20% wall-clock) and AC-04 (≥20% drop) in favor of a code-clarity metric — e.g. '≥95% of top-5-suite spawn sites converted (≤20 spawn sites remaining)'. Update F-01 + F-02 from 'fixed' to 'obsolete' (re-scoped out of M162). Update the M162 evidence field with the new metric and a one-paragraph note explaining why wall-clock was a poor target.
After each fix lands, update mp-dogfood-log.md Entry 23 + Entry 28 with `<!-- points-at: M175 -->` and a one-line status update (e.g. 'M175 fix landed in commit <sha>; re-verified via <test name>').
out_of_scope: Refactoring the skill registry data model — out of scope; this milestone is purely about the deploy path.
Touching harness-specific paths (Cursor / OpenCode / Pi) beyond the recursive deploy — those harnesses already differ at the harness config level, not the skill file level.
Converting the bottom-N suites (suite_install, suite_track, suite_brief, etc.) — out of M175 scope; the top-5 cover the dominant spawn surface (392 of 580 total per the M162 measurement).
Performance work beyond the spawn-site conversion — broader cold/warm perf is a separate track (M176).
Re-running the bulk lifecycle migration or any plan-zone data move.

findings.description: S2 conversion uses lib_api::run (clap+app::run with stdout capture) rather than pure domain wrappers for many sites. Meets ≤20 env.run goal (0 remaining) and is still in-process; domain wrappers remain preferred for new tests.

findings.description: AC-03 greps env.run only; residual Command::new sites are intentional CLI-boundary (install/lint/stdin). Documented; not blocking.

findings.description: Accepted strategy; domain wrappers preferred for new tests. Self F-01 already noted.

findings.summary: lib_api::run is CLI re-entry not pure domain

findings.description: install.rs uninstall builds skill_dir via harness::skill_dir_for(h, entry.skill_id) then fs::remove_dir_all without validate_skill_id. Deploy/registry paths validate; uninstall does not. A hand-edited/corrupt installed-skills.json with skill_id='..' (or other unvalidated id) can delete outside the skill root. Fix: validate_skill_id before delete; prefer entry.installed_path with containment check under skills root.
findings.fixed_in: M175 review remediations: safe uninstall + FdRestore + link/tree + run_at_repo isolation

findings.description: check_deployment_files prefers manifest installed_path for env-stable dest. uninstall always re-resolves skill_dir_for under current env. Sequence install@A → change MP_*_SKILL_DIR → uninstall@B leaves orphan package at A and forgets the manifest entry. Fix: delete PathBuf::from(entry.installed_path) when set (after containment), fall back to skill_dir_for only for legacy empty installed_path.
findings.fixed_in: M175 review remediations: safe uninstall + FdRestore + link/tree + run_at_repo isolation

findings.description: lib_api.rs capture_stdio: FdRestore is constructed only after both libc::dup2 calls (lines ~1014-1019). If the second dup2 fails or assert_eq! panics, fd 1 is already redirected and never restored — poisons stdout for remaining tests in-process. Prior F-02 claimed panic-safe restore but the pre-guard window remains. Fix: install guard before any dup2 with live flags, or restore on partial failure.
findings.fixed_in: M175 review remediations: safe uninstall + FdRestore + link/tree + run_at_repo isolation

findings.description: assert_skill_md_links_resolve only parses markdown [label](target). mp-flow references flow-stages.md/stages.toml via backticks; diagnosing-bugs references scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh the same way. Empty-link early return makes skill_link_targets_exist a no-op for the original M158 bug class on those skills. Fix: also extract backtick relative paths and/or assert full source tree lands under dest.
findings.fixed_in: M175 review remediations: safe uninstall + FdRestore + link/tree + run_at_repo isolation
findings.summary: AC-02 link helper no-ops for backtick-only skills

findings.description: AC-04 parity tests cover run/show weakly (cherry-picked keys); run_at_repo has zero parity. Subprocess TestEnv::run_at_repo sets isolated_harness_env (MP_*_SKILL_DIR); in-process run_at_repo only sets MP_HOME/MP_INSTALL_DIR — not a drop-in for install/skill paths. Fix: mirror isolated_harness_env under EnvRestore; add run_at_repo parity + stronger full-JSON compare on show path.
findings.fixed_in: M175 review remediations: safe uninstall + FdRestore + link/tree + run_at_repo isolation
